ruleDefinitions.name: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Service Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the installation of VsCode tunnel (code-tunnel) as a service.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*tunnel\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*service.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*internal\\-run.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*tunnel\\-service\\\.log.*"))
